sense: a message sent over the internet

pins.definition: A message sent over the internet, or the system for sending such messages.
A message or system for sending messages electronically over the internet.
A message sent electronically by computer or mobile phone.

situation: A tired woman sits in front of a glowing computer monitor late at night, watching a digital message arrive.
subject: the electronic message on the screen
brief: A woman sits in a dark room illuminated only by the cold blue light of a computer monitor displaying an open digital message window with a blinking cursor. The screen dominates the frame, casting a sharp glow across her face while the rest of the room fades into deep shadow.
prompt: A woman sits in a dark room illuminated only by the cold blue light of a computer monitor displaying an open digital message window with a blinking cursor. The screen dominates the frame, casting a sharp glow across her face while the rest of the room fades into deep shadow. a rain-slick neon night street, teal and magenta signage bleeding into volumetric haze, wet reflections, high dynamic range. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
